From: Claire Huang <claire@stratacorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nov 16 exec workshop — site readiness and requests

Hi Jonas,

We're finalizing logistics for the Nov 16 executive workshop (StrataCorp — SF + London touchpoints). A few asks before we lock the schedule: 

- Can you send a preflight checklist for onsite and remote (AV bridge, recording, security checkpoints)?
- Confirm headcount: we'll have ~16 execs in SF and 6 observers joining remotely; Redwood team size?
- Do you have a proposed arrival window for the Redwood facilitators and a local on-call contact for day-of ops?
- Any special equipment requests beyond a standard A/V package (e.g., dedicated streaming encoder, ISDN fallback)?

I've attached our site requirements doc and the venue's floor plan for reference. Also: we need to collect NDAs for three visiting researchers — is there a preferred DocuSign workflow for that?

Appreciate a short preflight and who from your ops team will be on-call.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Program Manager, Customer Events
StrataCorp

Hi Claire — thanks for the details and the attachments. High level below and attaching our preflight checklist (PDF) and a simplified floor-plan overlay with suggested breakout zones. Quick answers up front: 

- Redwood on-site facilitators: 4 (two leads, one producer, one engineer). Arrival window: 07:30–09:00 PST on Nov 16 (to allow staging).
- On-call ops: Logan Wright (cc'd) will be day-of lead; mobile +1 (415) 555-0183 and secondary contact in doc.
- AV: Standard A/V package will cover local projection and mixer. Recommend adding a dedicated hardware H.264 encoder for the live stream; we'll bring a backup USB audio interface. Fallback plan: cloud-recording + streaming fallback to alternate CDN.
- NDAs: DocuSign is fine — we can send a batch envelope from our legal template.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marissa to confirm travel roster and arrival times for the Redwood team.
2) Logan to confirm AV vendor contact and codec/fallback plan.
3) Claire to confirm final exec headcount and any dietary/accessibility notes.

I've attached: redwood-preflight-checklist-v1.pdf, venue_floorplan.pdf. Will follow up with a finalized itinerary once travel is confirmed.

Best,
